title: Ninety-eight goat doors
hook: Two stated cases: explore the unchosen probability mass.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the unchosen probability mass affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Switch, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the unchosen probability mass in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
